title: SQLite join and aggregation
final_response:
Done. I read `billing.sqlite` (read-only SELECTs only), joined `invoices` to `customers`, filtered to `status='paid'`, and exported the grouped totals to `regional.csv` sorted ascending by region:

```
region,total_cents,invoice_count
APAC,12500,2
EMEA,4000,1
```

Verified against the raw data: invoices 1 (10000) and 2 (2500) are paid in APAC → 12500; invoice 3 (4000) is paid in EMEA → 4000; invoice 4 (9000) is pending and correctly excluded.
